summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Drawing Revision & BOM Logic (Iter 36). All 6 major test scenarios passed successfully with 64 individual API tests executed. Verified SCOPE-based revision flow (drawing/bom/both), BOM submit-gate integration, and regression of existing approval workflows.

✅ Start Revision scope='both' - Drawing rev_no +1 & approval_status 'draft', BOM rev_no +1 & engineering_status 'draft', both have snapshot entries in revisions array
✅ Start Revision scope='bom' - Drawing approval_status UNCHANGED (remains pending_qc), drawing rev_no UNCHANGED, BOM rev_no +1 & engineering_status 'draft'
✅ Start Revision scope='drawing' - Drawing rev_no +1 & approval_status 'draft', BOM rev_no UNCHANGED (remains 0)
✅ BOM Submit-gate (Non-leader) - qa_eng_tmp submits drawing → drawing 'pending_eng_head', BOM 'pending_review'
✅ BOM Submit-gate (Leader) - qa_leader_tmp submits drawing → drawing 'pending_qc' (auto-verified), BOM 'approved' + procurement_status 'leader_checked'
✅ Authentication - All test accounts (qa_eng_tmp, qa_leader_tmp, qa_admin_tmp) login successfully
✅ Drawing Creation - Auto-generate drawing numbers with customer code ZZTEST
✅ BOM Creation - Auto-generate BOM numbers and link to drawings
✅ BOM Items - Successfully add multiple items to BOM
✅ PDF Upload - Upload drawing PDFs with embedded drawing numbers
✅ Work Category - Set work category (simple/moderate/complex) before submission
✅ Approval Workflow - Sequential approval flow (draft → pending_eng_head → pending_qc)
✅ ECN Request - Request revision with scope parameter
✅ ECN Approval - Engineering leader approves revision requests
✅ Start Revision - Execute revision with scope-based logic
